_note: 管道层（Bindings）：类型层对象/链接的数据从哪来、怎么清洗、怎么物化。object_bindings: source(结构化 {table, columns:{别名:源列}}，编译期按属性类型 CAST) 或 source_sql(自由查询)；clean 清洗规则；optional 源表缺失可跳过。link_bindings: build_sql 物化边（引用 obj_*/lnk_*）。

object_bindings.source_sql: SELECT 主体 AS raw_name FROM 通话记录 UNION SELECT 对端 FROM 通话记录 UNION SELECT 主体 FROM 轨迹出行 UNION SELECT 主体 FROM 公开OSINT UNION SELECT 主体 FROM 银行流水 UNION SELECT 被举报人 AS raw_name FROM 举报材料
SELECT 主体 AS raw_name FROM 银行流水 UNION SELECT 对方 FROM 银行流水

link_bindings.build_sql: SELECT txn_id, from_raw AS from_account, to_raw AS to_account, amount, date FROM obj_transaction
SELECT c.call_id, p1.person_id AS from_person, p2.person_id AS to_person FROM obj_call c LEFT JOIN obj_person p1 ON p1.raw_name = c.caller_raw LEFT JOIN obj_person p2 ON p2.raw_name = c.callee_raw
SELECT a.account_id, p.person_id AS owner_person, a.raw_name AS owner_raw FROM obj_account a JOIN obj_person p ON p.raw_name = a.raw_name
SELECT o.org_id, b.project_id, b.winner_raw FROM obj_bid_project b JOIN obj_org o ON o.raw_name = b.winner_raw

SELECT t1.track_id AS track_id_1, t2.track_id AS track_id_2, p1.person_id AS person_1, p2.person_id AS person_2, t1.location, t1.date FROM obj_trackpoint t1 JOIN obj_trackpoint t2 ON t1.location = t2.location AND t1.person_raw <> t2.person_raw AND ABS(date_diff('day', CAST(t1.date AS DATE), CAST(t2.date AS DATE))) <= 1 LEFT JOIN obj_person p1 ON p1.raw_name = t1.person_raw LEFT JOIN obj_person p2 ON p2.raw_name = t2.person_raw

link_bindings._note: 链接只表达时间邻接关系（中标公示 ±20 天有资金交易）；整数资金/排除公司等检测判据在规则层（rules.json R6 → function time_window_collision 参数），不污染链接物化。
link_bindings.build_sql: SELECT b.project_id, t.txn_id, b.title, t.from_raw AS owner_raw, t.amount, date_diff('day', CAST(b.pub_date AS DATE), CAST(t.date AS DATE)) AS offset_days FROM obj_bid_project b JOIN obj_transaction t ON ABS(date_diff('day', CAST(b.pub_date AS DATE), CAST(t.date AS DATE))) <= 20
SELECT t.tipoff_id, p.person_id, t.target_raw, t.title AS tip_type, t.submit_date FROM obj_tipoff t JOIN obj_person p ON p.raw_name = t.target_raw
SELECT a.article_id, p.person_id, a.raw_name AS subject_raw, a.source_name, a.pub_date FROM obj_osint_article a JOIN obj_person p ON p.raw_name = a.raw_name
